project_specification.project_name: nullius — feature 268 (System rejects publishing the raw in-campaign rate as a dashboard number, reporting FDR_deploy as the headline figure)
project_specification.addition_summary: Implement app_spec.xml feature 268 in the existing scoring plugin (packages/scoring, import name scoring; the app-package seat is src/app/modules/scoring): the *publication seam* that closes the calibration chain and is the reason the FDR_deploy store (feature 267) exists. The sentence is docs/alpha-engine-prd.md §4.1.3 line 151: "`FDR_deploy` is the headline number. The raw in-campaign rate is an artifact of a design choice and must never be the figure on the dashboard." The act is a single verb, `headline(campaign, *, figures, store=None)`, that answers the one figure a dashboard's headline slot may show for a closed campaign — the base-rate-reweighted `FDR_deploy` — and refuses to answer the raw in-campaign rate in that role. It takes the campaign id and feature 266's calibration `CalibrationFigures` (the base-rate-independent pair), reweights the pair to the deployment base rate via feature 267's pure `fdr_deploy` (π₀ = 0.9, spelled once as a constant), and answers the one bare float. It is a pure function of evidence the factory does not hold (the campaign id and the figures), so it adds no new `@register` component and is reached directly from the member (`from scoring import headline`), the way feature 263's `regime_aggregate` and feature 264's `regime_strata` are. Its refusal is the whole point: a caller that reaches for the raw in-campaign rate — the figure prd §4.1.3 bars from the dashboard — is refused by name, and a caller that hands the pair but no store is refused rather than silently publishing nowhere. No central registry, router, app factory, middleware, settings or migration is edited; the member joins by workspace-scan convention and does not import another workspace member — the figures and the store arrive duck-typed across the same "no member imports another" seam the calibration and FDR modules already take.

existing_context.stack: Python 3.12 / uv-workspace (packages/scoring member, import name scoring; the FDR store is `scoring._fdr`, the calibration figures are `scoring._calibration.CalibrationFigures`, the scorer process is `scoring._scorer.NullPickScorer`, the app-package seat is src/app/modules/scoring with its sibling seats scorer.py and fdr.py). pytest (ruff conventions; mypy absent). The module loader (src/app/module_loader.py) discovers members from the root pyproject.toml `[tool.uv.workspace] members = ["packages/*"]`, imports each package so its module-level `@register` fires, and composes what each `@register` builder contributes under a component name. `app` (src/app) is a namespace package; the scoring seat (src/app/modules/scoring) answers *what is the composed per-world objective?* and the sibling seats answer the same shape of question for 265's process and 267's store. A member never imports another member — it reaches shared shapes through `app.*` or restates them, never through a sibling package's import name.
existing_context.test_baseline: The scoring member's own suite under packages/scoring/tests/ (test_fdr, test_fdr_store, test_fdr_component, test_calibration, test_scorer, test_accounting, test_nullpicks, test_component, test_cross_member, …) plus the seat suite at src/app/modules/scoring (test_app_module). The member is stdlib-only at module scope (the factory's scan imports the package to fire its `@register` builders, so it must pay nothing). The repository-level suite under tests/ is collected by pytest's testpaths and does NOT collect packages/*/tests (see the acceptance-gate memory), so the member's own suite must be run explicitly as well. Lint only the new files and compare to a sibling — the repo is red on main (~163 pre-existing ruff errors), so a baseline via `--stdin-filename` misreports.
existing_context.conventions: - One act, one module: `headline.py` holds the `headline` verb and the refusal; `__init__.py` re-exports the new name and carries no logic, the shape every member in this workspace takes. - No `@register` component and no seat: the publication verb is a pure function of evidence the factory does not hold (the campaign id and the figures), exactly the argument the scoring member's own docstring makes for every free law in this category past the two state-bound components (265's process, 267's store). Reached directly from the member. - The pair is handed over, never derived: `headline` takes feature 266's `CalibrationFigures` (the two base-rate-independent figures) and reweights them; it never reads a label, never touches a sidecar, never computes sensitivity or specificity. The store is duck-typed (a carrier exposing `fdr(campaign)` and `persist`), never `isinstance` — the module loader imports a member under a synthetic name and re-executes it, so a composed application serves a *second* class object of the same shape; a type gate would refuse the very value the composition seam hands out. - One bare float out, and it is the reweighted figure: `headline` answers `fdr_deploy(figures)` — feature 267's one formula over the pair at the one constant π₀ = 0.9 — never the raw in-campaign rate, never a count, never a third figure. The refusal is the act: the raw rate is refused by name as prd §4.1.3's artifact of φ. - The store is duck-typed and optional: `store` arrives as a carrier exposing the store's own verbs (`persist(campaign, figures)`, `fdr(campaign)`, `history()`); when the caller names no store, the verb is refused rather than silently publishing nowhere, because the figure is prd §11's primary target read across campaigns and a headline with no backing row is exactly the quietly-defaulted number this seam exists to rule out. - Error vocabulary splits by *what the caller must do about it*: the publication refusal is a sibling of `FdrDeployError` (the projection/persist) and `CalibrationFiguresError` (the pair), never a child — a caller catching them together would read the wrong repair (a headline-role refusal is not a malformed pair and not a corrupt row). It opens with a greppable code (`raw_rate_as_headline`), the `pool_frozen` / `unwalkable_tree` precedent. - Validation is total before the answer: a non-UUID campaign id, a carrier that is not the pair, a figure that is not a finite real in [0, 1], the 0/0 corner (sensitivity 0.0, specificity 1.0), and the raw-rate-as-headline refusal all fire before the float is answered, so a refused headline answers nothing. - Stdlib only, import-cheap: the member's own `fdr_deploy` and `DEPLOYMENT_BASE_RATE` (reached through the member namespace, never re-spelled), the member's own `RATE_BOUND` and `ScoringError`, and the member's own error — no third-party import at module scope.

feature.description: System rejects publishing the raw in-campaign rate as a dashboard number, reporting FDR_deploy as the headline figure. The publication seam is a single verb `headline(campaign, *, figures, store=None)` that answers the one figure a dashboard's headline slot may show for a closed campaign — the base-rate-reweighted `FDR_deploy` — and refuses to answer the raw in-campaign rate in that role. It takes the campaign id (a UUID — the row's key joins `node.campaign_id` and the discovery member's campaign record, so an id that cannot join names no campaign) and feature 266's calibration `CalibrationFigures` (the base-rate-independent sensitivity/specificity pair), reweights the pair to the deployment base rate via feature 267's pure `fdr_deploy` (π₀ = 0.9, spelled once as a constant, never a parameter), and answers the one bare float. It is a pure function of evidence the factory does not hold, so it adds no new `@register` component and is reached directly from the member (`from scoring import headline`), the way feature 263's `regime_aggregate` and feature 264's `regime_strata` are. The steps, in the order they must happen: (1) validate the campaign id is a UUID and the store surface (when a store is named) — a non-UUID id names no campaign a figure could be published for, and a store that exposes no readable `fdr`/`persist` names no backing row; (2) validate the figures are feature 266's pair — a bare number is refused by name as the raw in-campaign rate, prd §4.1.3's artifact of φ and the figure barred from the dashboard; (3) reweight the pair via `fdr_deploy` — the 0/0 corner (sensitivity 0.0, specificity 1.0) is refused as feature 266's honest answer for a campaign that committed to nothing; (4) answer the one bare float, the reweighted figure, never the raw rate, never a count, never a third figure. A refused headline answers nothing.

System exposes `HeadlineError(ScoringError)`, the publication seam's refusal vocabulary — a sibling of `FdrDeployError` (the projection/persist) and `CalibrationFiguresError` (the pair), never a child, for the reason the errors module states for every later refusal in this category: a caller catching them together would read the wrong repair (a headline-role refusal is not a malformed pair and not a corrupt row). It opens every message with the greppable code `raw_rate_as_headline` (the `pool_frozen` / `unwalkable_tree` precedent), so an operator greps one word for the refusal. Its faces: the **campaign** — an id that is not a UUID, naming the id (it names no campaign a figure could be published for); the **store** — a named store that exposes no readable `fdr`/`persist`, or no store at all when one is required, naming the absence (the figure is prd §11's primary target read across campaigns, and a headline with no backing row is the quietly-defaulted number this seam exists to rule out); the **figures** — a bare number, refused by name as the raw in-campaign rate (prd §4.1.3's artifact of φ, the figure barred from the dashboard — no arithmetic on one number recovers the two the reweighting needs), or a carrier that exposes no readable `sensitivity`/`specificity`, or a figure that is not a finite real in [0, 1]; and the **corner** — the pair sensitivity 0.0, specificity 1.0 (feature 266's honest answer for a campaign that committed to nothing, whose projection is 0/0 at every base rate — no declaration was ever made, so no fraction of declarations is defined, and unknown is not zero). No partial value escapes a refusal: the verb either answers one bare float or raises.

System reweights the calibration pair to the deployment base rate through feature 267's `fdr_deploy` — the publication seam's one formula, never re-spelled. `headline` delegates the arithmetic to `fdr_deploy(figures)` (the free verb, pure and deterministic, reached through the member namespace rather than imported as a second spelling), handing feature 266's `CalibrationFigures` — or any carrier exposing its two figures — so the pair this seam publishes is exactly the pair feature 266 measured and feature 267 persists, reweighted at the one constant `DEPLOYMENT_BASE_RATE` (π₀ = 0.9). A bare number handed where the pair belongs is refused before the reweighting (feature 267's own `FdrDeployError` names it as the raw in-campaign rate; this seam's `HeadlineError` names it as the figure barred from the dashboard — the same refusal, at the publication role). The 0/0 corner (sensitivity 0.0, specificity 1.0) is refused by feature 267's own law and propagates as `HeadlineError`, because a headline the dashboard shows cannot be the projection of a campaign that made no declaration. The constant is never a parameter: a caller able to pick π₀ could pick the figure the dashboard shows and the M3 gate judges, so the projection this seam publishes is *the* deployment projection, reweighted once, at the end, in one place.

System reaches the FDR_deploy store duck-typed and optionally — the publication seam's store half. `store` arrives as a carrier exposing the store's own verbs — `persist(campaign, figures)` (the per-campaign write) and `fdr(campaign)` (the one-campaign read) — read by what the carrier *is*, never by `isinstance`, because the module loader imports a member under a synthetic name and re-executes it, so a composed application serves a *second* class object of the same shape and a type gate would refuse the very value composition handed out. When a store is named, `headline` writes the campaign's figure through `persist(campaign, figures)` (refreshed-not-appended, the first `computed_at` kept — feature 267's upsert law) and reads it back through `fdr(campaign)` to answer, so the published float is the row the store holds, rebuilt from the pair, not a recomputed value that could drift. When no store is named (`store=None`), the verb is refused as `HeadlineError` rather than answering a float with no backing row — the figure is prd §11's primary target read across campaigns, and a headline with a hole where the campaign's row should be is exactly the quietly-defaulted number this seam exists to rule out. The store is never imported: it arrives across the "no member imports another" seam, the same stance feature 267's seat and the FDR store's own resolution take.

System passes an end-to-end publication: a closed campaign's `CalibrationFigures` (e.g. sensitivity 0.9, specificity 0.9, over a planted population the caller declares) publishes as the reweighted `FDR_deploy` (≈0.5 at π₀ = 0.9), the store ends holding one row for the campaign (read back through `fdr`, rebuilt from the stored pair), and the published float equals the store's figure; a bare number handed as the figures is refused as `raw_rate_as_headline` (prd §4.1.3's artifact of φ) with nothing published; a non-UUID campaign id is refused naming the id; the 0/0 corner (sensitivity 0.0, specificity 1.0) is refused as the projection of a campaign that committed to nothing; and a named store that exposes no readable `fdr`/`persist` is refused. A re-run over the same campaign and pair is idempotent by the store's own law (refresh keeps the first `computed_at`), and a re-measured pair lands the new projection — feature 267's refresh-not-append, restated at the publication seam. The published figure is always the reweighted one: exact anchors hold (a pair that projects to 0.9 publishes 0.9; a pair that projects to 0.0 publishes 0.0), and the raw in-campaign rate is never the published float at any value.

project_specification.integration_points: Reaches feature 267's pure `fdr_deploy` (the reweighting) and `DEPLOYMENT_BASE_RATE` (π₀ = 0.9) through the member namespace (`scoring.fdr_deploy`), never re-spelled — the pair this seam publishes is exactly the pair feature 266 measured and feature 267 reweights. Reaches feature 266's `CalibrationFigures` as the figures carrier — the base-rate-independent sensitivity/specificity pair — and feature 267's `FdrDeployStore` duck-typed (its `persist`/`fdr` verbs) for the backing row. Reuses the member's own `RATE_BOUND`, `ScoringError` and the FDR-store refusal path (`FdrDeployError`), translated into the publication vocabulary (`HeadlineError`) at the seam. No `@register` component is added (the publication verb is a pure function of evidence the factory does not hold; the scoring member's three components — the objective, 265's process, 267's store — are untouched), no seat is widened (reached directly from the member), and no endpoint, table or migration is added. Does not import another workspace member: the figures and the store arrive duck-typed across the same "no member imports another" seam the calibration, FDR and accounting modules already take.
project_specification.constraints: - No member imports another: the figures (`CalibrationFigures`) and the store (`FdrDeployStore`) are duck-typed; validate `sensitivity`/ `specificity` off the figures and `persist`/`fdr` off the store, and translate every refusal into this seam's own vocabulary. - No new `@register` component and no seat edit: `headline` is a pure function of evidence the factory does not hold, reached directly from the member (`from scoring import headline`). - No new table, endpoint or migration: the published figure lands in feature 267's `scoring_fdr_deploy` through feature 267's store. - Do not edit a central registry, router, app factory, middleware, settings or migration (core-task, order-sensitive shared files). - One bare float out, and it is the reweighted figure: `headline` answers `fdr_deploy(figures)` at the one constant π₀ = 0.9, never the raw in-campaign rate, never a count, never a third figure. - The raw in-campaign rate is refused by name (`raw_rate_as_headline`) as prd §4.1.3's artifact of φ — the figure barred from the dashboard. - Validation is total before the answer: a non-UUID campaign id, a carrier that is not the pair, a figure not a finite real in [0, 1], the 0/0 corner, and the raw-rate-as-headline refusal all fire before the float is answered, so a refused headline answers nothing. - The store is optional but not silently skippable: `store=None` is refused, not defaulted, because the figure is prd §11's primary target read across campaigns. - Stdlib only and import-cheap at module scope; the factory's scan pays nothing for the publication verb.

implementation_steps.phase: 1. Create `packages/scoring/src/scoring/headline.py`. Import stdlib only at module scope (`uuid`, `typing`); reach `fdr_deploy`, `DEPLOYMENT_BASE_RATE`, `RATE_BOUND` and `ScoringError` through the member namespace, never re-spell them. 2. Define `HeadlineError(ScoringError)` and the `RAW_RATE_AS_HEADLINE` code constant; write the four-faced messages (campaign, store, figures, corner), each opening with the code and naming what it is about. 3. Write the campaign-id validation (a UUID — refuse a non-UUID naming the id) and the store-surface validation (a carrier exposing callable `persist` and `fdr`; refuse one that does not, and refuse the absence when `store=None`). 4. Write the figures validation (feature 266's pair — refuse a bare number as `raw_rate_as_headline`, refuse a carrier with no readable `sensitivity`/`specificity`, refuse a figure not a finite real in [0, 1]). 5. Write `headline(campaign, *, figures, store=None)`: validate id + store + figures, reweight the pair via `fdr_deploy`, persist through the store (when named) and read the figure back, and answer the one bare float. A refused headline answers nothing. 6. Re-export `headline` and `HeadlineError` from `packages/scoring/src/scoring/__init__.py` (`__all__` widened), carrying no logic. 7. Write `packages/scoring/tests/test_headline.py` (the verb, the reweighted figure, the four refusal faces, the exact anchors, the store round-trip read back through raw SQL) and extend `test_cross_member.py` to pin that the published figure equals the store's row and the raw rate is never the published float, driven through the real `fdr_deploy`. 8. Lint the new files only, comparing to a sibling; run both the member suite and the seat suite.

project_specification.success_criteria: - `claw-forge validate-spec additions_spec_268.xml` reports `clean` with zero errors (INFO advisories and the known brownfield warnings that also appear in `skipped_layers` are not blockers). - `headline` answers the reweighted `FDR_deploy` (the one bare float) for a closed campaign's `CalibrationFigures`, and the published figure equals the store's row, read back through the store. - The raw in-campaign rate is refused by name (`raw_rate_as_headline`) as prd §4.1.3's artifact of φ, at any value, and is never the published float. - A non-UUID campaign id, a carrier that is not the pair, a figure not a finite real in [0, 1], the 0/0 corner, and a missing store are all refused as `HeadlineError` with nothing published. - No new `@register` component, no seat edit, no table, endpoint or migration; the member suite (packages/scoring/tests) and the seat suite (src/app/modules/scoring) both pass, stdlib-only at module scope, and lint is clean on the new files.
